text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, there are little bumps all over 
your cheeks...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Just because I finished cutting weight, I 
might've eaten a little too much...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It really is so good... Chocolate after 
finishing a weight cut, that is...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, this is bad. I'm starting to 
crave it again. Althoughâ

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I guess chocolate is out of the question 
until these bumps go away, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute was feeling down over her 
rough skin.
